# Tech Feed Watch

> Written analyses of notable tech videos - AI, fintech, crypto, cybersecurity, hardware and more. Every article credits the original creator and links to the source video.

Tech Feed Watch turns YouTube videos worth watching into articles worth reading. Each piece is a standalone analysis of the subject, written with the video as research, not a summary of it. The method is documented openly on the About page. All articles carry structured data (JSON-LD), a table of contents, and a FAQ.

## Start here

- [Start Here](https://techfeedwatch.com/start-here/) - what the site is, how it works, where to begin
- [About](https://techfeedwatch.com/about/) - who runs it and how articles are made
- [Latest articles](https://techfeedwatch.com/latest/)
- [Video Library](https://techfeedwatch.com/library/) - full archive, filterable by topic

## Reference

- [Guides](https://techfeedwatch.com/guides/) - nine long-form guides built from patterns across the archive
- [Glossary](https://techfeedwatch.com/glossary/) - 50 tech terms, each explained in about thirty seconds
- [Free tools](https://techfeedwatch.com/tools/) - browser-based tools; nothing you paste is uploaded
- [Trends](https://techfeedwatch.com/trends/) - what the archive shows over time, with its limits stated

## Usage

Content may be cited with attribution and a link. See robots.txt for crawler permissions and content signals.
